Merged prerequisite update for #10358 / #10331: [PR #10967](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/pull/10967) landed at `0738244bdda275a1273fc28a444cabc424dcf71e`, using `gh pr merge --squash --auto --match-head-commit d8fdc8fb0349a3c174c33ddb80a27322fed5aafc` without branch deletion. The recorded fresh Opus review found no blockers; the rebased head preserved the reviewed code except the documented checker-allowlist reconciliation. Exact-head CI run 39175085494 is confirmed completed/success, with its build job successful and no failed or cancelled steps. This was an existing reviewed prerequisite PR, not a new issue or dispatch.

The artifact exposes `NumberField.Presentation.model_eq`; the actual adapter's `NumberField.model_read` consumes it through ordinary imports. `import all HexRealClosureTheory.NumberFieldTower` is removed and the existing DAG checker seals that owner boundary. The equation, consumer proof and native interpretation remain ordinary-kernel checked; no model/arithmetic/search algorithm is changed.

The continuing worker integrated current main without conflicts at local merge `e928d26d22ba0468004056542084eb7158778a9a`. The actual owner module, NumberField consumer, native algebraic-cell regressions, original-source preparation/acceptance conformance and optional umbrella pass together: 11,169 Lake jobs with cached dependencies reused, 5min9.528s, peak 5.2 GiB/no swap, under the serial hard 32 GiB/two-thread cap. The preparation checks include original zero guards, false/empty-domain sources, ordered irrational/guard-only inputs, aggregate budgets, forged inventories and transactional refusal. A full current manual/fresh source-goal audit is still running; it is not yet claimed complete.

This removes the private presentation-model boundary from the remaining gates. It does not supply numerical canonical-frame encoding, arbitrary frozen history/operation-record discovery, general joint finite replay realization or full automatic tactic integration. #10984 is still unmerged and its mandatory Opus review remains pending; general #10378 exporter obligations remain. #10358 stays OPEN. Existing draft #10981's source/goal work remains unmerged pending its actual fresh Opus review and final-head green. No owner proof copy, new issue/PR/worker or downstream dispatch; #10331 retains coordination.
